findings.value: A Grade II-listed art deco building that opened as a cinema in 1933, was later used as an opera school and bingo hall, and now hosts concerts, club nights and other events.

evidence.quote: Troxy first opened its doors in 1933
It spent time as an opera school and a bingo hall, but now hosts events

findings.value: Time Out lists concerts and club nights alongside MMA fights and immersive cinema.

evidence.quote: MMA fights, immersive cinema, club nights and a huge range of live music concerts

findings.value: The venue says everyone is welcome and that its staff are trained to make visits inclusive.

evidence.quote: All staff at the venue are highly trained to create a fully inclusive customer experience

notes: Time Out's review (dated 10 March 2023) has 'More: Temporarily closed' in its page metadata, not in its text, and the venue's own pages are current (FAQ updated June 2026; event sitemap updated 12 October 2026). No status proposed; the editor may want to check the tag. Time Out names no music genres for Troxy.
